design_reference: Editeur Livre-Jeu - Wireframes.dc.html § 02 « Choix sortants », § 05 hidden-prereq + countdown mechanics, § 06 A « Créer une nouvelle branche » + B « Relier à un nœud existant » (search popover + dashed « fuite ↻ » relink edge). Anatomy + tokens from styles.css. Low-fi, light theme.

plan.goal: Manage a node's outgoing choices: create a new child branch, relink a choice to an existing node, and configure per-choice rules — hidden prerequisite (requires an inventory object) and countdown (expires to a default node).
acceptance_criteria: A node's outgoing choices are listed as rows showing the destination title and a badge per active rule; the list is read from BookService and reflects edges live (edge:* events).

« + Nouvelle branche » creates a new child node via BookService, links it from this choice with a `choice` edge, and selects the new node (emits node:created + edge:created{kind:'choice'} + node:selected); the new node starts empty with placeholders.

« Relier… » opens a searchable list of existing nodes; selecting one creates a `relink` edge from this choice to that node (edge:created{kind:'relink'}) without creating a node, enabling cycles/convergence; the canvas renders it dashed. Structural screens (the Sommaire root, the Mort leaf) are excluded from the candidates and rejected at the SSOT — Mort is reached only automatically in combat (KR-067).

Toggling « pré-requis caché » on a choice and picking a required object persists a hidden-prerequisite rule referencing an ObjectCatalogService object id; the row shows the ⊘ badge; clearing the toggle removes the rule.
Toggling « compte à rebours » persists a délai + a fallback destination node; the row shows the ⏱ badge; the fallback target must resolve to an existing node.
The countdown délai is a délai control (the shared brain Stepper) defaulting to 15 s and bounded to 5–60 s — the Stepper clamps, so the value can never leave the range.
Removing a choice deletes its edge (edge:deleted) and, for the relink case, never deletes the target node — only the edge; deleting a `choice` branch prompts about its now-orphaned child if any.
A required-object reference pointing at a deleted object, or a fallback/relink target pointing at a deleted node, is detected and surfaced (not silently broken).
All controls render from design-system components/tokens, light theme; the relink search is keyboard-navigable and rules have ≥44px targets.
plan.walking_skeleton: Render the selected node's outgoing choices from BookService inside node-editor's choices slot (mounted via the brain SlotRegistry, no cross-feature import). « + branche » creates+links+selects a child (node:created/edge:created/node:selected). « Relier… » lists existing nodes and creates a relink edge. Remove deletes only the edge. Hidden-prereq/countdown deferred (need ObjectCatalogService).

iterations.goal: Choice rows + new branch (§ 06 A): list outgoing choices as rows with rule badges; each row exposes an editable « libellé du choix » persisted on the edge (Edge.label) via BookService, with an inviting placeholder when empty; « + Nouvelle branche » creates+links+selects a child with placeholders; emit the three events. DS fidelity.
Relink (§ 06 B): searchable node popover, create a `relink`/`fuite` edge enabling cycles/convergence; canvas dashed; guard self-link and duplicate edges (KR-061).
Hidden prerequisite (§ 05): toggle + required-object picker referencing ObjectCatalogService by id; choice hidden unless owned; ⊘ badge; clean removal (KR-062).
Countdown (§ 05): toggle + délai + fallback-node Select with validation; ⏱ badge; referential-integrity sweep for deleted targets/objects (KR-063).

known_risks: KR-060 — Edges are the book's structure: all create/delete goes through BookService so tree-canvas + outline-view + game-preview agree; never mutate edges locally (re-asserts KR-020).

KR-061 — Relink allows cycles/convergence by DESIGN but must guard degenerate cases: no duplicate identical edges, sane self-link handling, and the target node is never created/deleted by relinking (only the edge).

KR-062 — Hidden prerequisite references an object by STABLE id, not by name; a dangling reference (deleted object / none chosen) must be detected, not silently true/false. Implemented against a DERIVED catalog (brain collectObjects, a pure VIEW over the book), not an owned ObjectCatalogService — objects stay owned on their nodes (no desync); the rule rides Edge.prereq via updateEdge.
KR-063 — Countdown fallback + relink targets are node references that can dangle if the target is deleted; run a referential-integrity check and surface broken targets (re-asserts KR-021).
KR-064 — Deleting a `choice` branch may orphan its child subtree; prompt/handle explicitly (don't silently leave unreachable nodes or cascade-delete without consent).
KR-065 — A choice may hold BOTH a hidden prerequisite and a countdown; the countdown only ticks while the choice is visible (prerequisite met), so a hidden choice never expires invisibly.

KR-066 — node-editor mounts choice-linking via the brain SlotRegistry (SLOT_NODE_EDITOR_CHOICES); the host renders the registered renderer and falls back to a placeholder if none — neither feature imports the other.
KR-055/060 — Mort is structural: BookService rejects outgoing edges from it (addChoiceBranch/addEdge), enforcing the invariant at the SSOT, not just by hiding the UI.

KR-067 — Structural screens are never authored choice targets: the Sommaire root has no incoming choices and the Mort leaf is reached only automatically at the end of a combat. BookService.addEdge rejects a sommaire/mort target and the relink picker excludes them — enforced at the SSOT and the UI.
KR-011 — No raw localStorage; edges/rules via BookService/ObjectCatalogService.
KR-013 — Derive row/rule view-state inline from book data, not useEffect mirrors.

iterations_log.label: walking-skeleton
architecture_choices: New brain SlotRegistry (KR-066): node-editor reserves SLOT_NODE_EDITOR_CHOICES and renders whatever is registered; choice-linking registers an OutgoingChoices renderer at the composition root (App useEffect). Neither feature imports the other — same OCP seam as ActionRegistry but for panel regions.

Edge mutation lives in BookService (the SSOT, KR-060): addChoiceBranch (new child + choice edge, node:created then edge:created), addEdge (relink to an existing node, enabling cycles), removeEdge (deletes only the edge, never the target node). edge:created payload extended with from/to + typed EdgeKind.
Mort's no-outgoing invariant enforced at the SSOT (KR-055/060): addChoiceBranch/addEdge reject a Mort source, not just the hidden UI.
OutgoingChoices is a live VIEW via useOpenBook (no private copy, KR-020); the relink picker is local UI state, not derived-from-props (KR-013).
deviations_from_plan: Skeleton banks the core of iter 1 (choice rows + « + branche ») and iter 2 (relink) but WITHOUT the iter-2 self-link/duplicate-edge guards (KR-061) — those formalise iter 2 in tier 0.3.x.
Hidden prerequisite (iter 3) and countdown (iter 4) are deferred: they need ObjectCatalogService, which lands with action-decor. Rule badges on rows arrive with those iterations.
« Relier… » uses a simple inline node list, not the fuzzy search popover (iter 2 polish).

test_coverage.unit: BookService addChoiceBranch/addEdge/removeEdge — event order, relink-no-node, Mort-source rejection, unknown endpoints, target-node survives removal
test_coverage.integration: OutgoingChoices via App: slot mount + empty state, « + branche » create+link+select, « Relier… » relink edge, remove-edge-keeps-node

iterations_log.label: iteration-1
architecture_choices: Editable « libellé du choix » rides the edge (Edge.label), the book's structure, so it persists through a new BookService.updateEdge (EdgePatch) — the SSOT for every edge mutation (KR-060/020). A blank label is DROPPED at the SSOT (not stored as '') so every consumer falls back to the kind's canvas label via `?? canvasLabel` — an empty edge.label must never render as a blank button; undefined leaves the field untouched.

New brain edge:updated event added to AppEvents and to the useOpenBook BOOK_MUTATION_EVENTS list, so the panel row AND the canvas (which already renders edge.label ?? canvasLabel) re-read live on a label change — no useEffect mirror (KR-013).

The row became a small two-line card (header line: → destination + kind badge + delete; second line: the libellé Field) with an inviting placeholder; the Field carries an ariaLabel naming its destination so it stays accessible without a visible label.

The libellé is shown on EVERY outgoing row (choice + relink), consistent with the canvas honouring edge.label for all kinds; rule badges (⊘ prereq / ⏱ countdown) wait for iterations 3–4 (no rules exist yet).
deviations_from_plan: « Rule badges » in the iter-1 goal are deferred to iters 3–4: there are no per-choice rules yet (hidden-prereq/countdown need ObjectCatalogService), so only the edge-kind badge renders. The label-editing slice is the substantive iter-1 addition over the skeleton.

test_coverage.unit: BookService.updateEdge — sets/persists the label + emits edge:updated, clears with '', null for missing book/edge
test_coverage.integration: OutgoingChoices via App: typing a libellé persists it on the edge; empty field shows the placeholder

iterations_log.label: iteration-2
architecture_choices: Self-link + duplicate-edge guards land at the SSOT (BookService.addEdge), not just the picker (KR-061): addEdge rejects `from === to` and any edge whose from/to/kind already exists, returning null and emitting nothing. Identity is from+to+kind — a second edge to the same target of a DIFFERENT kind (e.g. relink then flee) is legitimate convergence, not a duplicate.

The relink picker mirrors both SSOT guards so it never offers a rejected target: the current node is excluded (self-link) and any node already reached by a `relink` from here is excluded (duplicate). The SSOT stays the law; the picker is convenience.

The « Relier… » popover became searchable (§ 06 B): a brain Field filters candidates by title (case-insensitive substring), derived inline from the live candidate list (KR-013) — no useEffect mirror. The field autofocuses on open so the popover is keyboard-operable immediately; an empty filtered list shows « Aucun nœud ne correspond », distinct from the « Aucun autre nœud » no-candidates state.
Opening/closing the popover and committing a relink reset the query (toggleRelink/relinkTo) so a stale needle never leaks into the next open.
deviations_from_plan: « fuite » edges are created only by the future automatic combat-flee path, not authored here; the relink button mints a `relink` edge. The duplicate guard is kind-aware, so that automatic path can still add a `flee` to a node already reached by a `relink`.

test_coverage.unit: BookService.addEdge — rejects self-link, rejects a duplicate identical edge (no edge:created emitted), allows a same-target edge of a different kind
test_coverage.integration: OutgoingChoices via App: the search box filters candidates, an already-relinked node is excluded, a non-matching needle shows the distinct empty message

iterations_log.label: iteration-3 (hidden prerequisite)
architecture_choices: The object catalog (KR-062) is a DERIVED VIEW, not an owned store (user decision): brain/utils/objects.ts collectObjects(book) unions every acquirable object already authored on a node (décor « prendre » takeables + the deprecated single object, the PNJ gift, the monster loot), de-duped by id. Objects stay owned where they are authored (KR-020, no ObjectCatalogService to desync); the picker references one by stable id (KR-062). collectObjects/findObject are pure brain utils reused by future play mode (KR-110).

The rule lives on the choice EDGE as Edge.prereq?: ChoicePrereq ({ objectId }, '' = chosen-but-unconfigured), persisted via BookService.updateEdge — EdgePatch gained `prereq: ChoicePrereq | null` where null CLEARS the rule and an omitted key leaves it untouched, mirroring the label-drop pattern (the SSOT stores intent only; the label and prereq are independent and editing one never drops the other).

OutgoingChoices recomputes the catalog inline from the live book (KR-013) and validates each rule at the VIEW: a resolved id shows the ⊘ « pré-requis » badge, a dangling one (deleted object, or '' unconfigured) shows the ⚠ « pré-requis » badge — surfaced, never silently met (KR-062/021).

The per-row rule UI was extracted to a ChoicePrereqEditor component (toggle « pré-requis caché » + a native object Select + dangling message) so OutgoingChoices stays under the 400-line split signal (KR-112). Controlled — the owner persists via updateEdge.
deviations_from_plan: « ObjectCatalogService » in the iter-3 goal is realised as the pure derived helper collectObjects, not a new owned brain service — the cleaner design (objects already carry stable ids on their nodes; an owned copy would risk desync). Everything references by id, so a future owned catalog can replace collectObjects transparently. Countdown (iter 4) + a full referential-integrity sweep stay for the V4 tier (KR-063).

test_coverage.unit: collectObjects (gathers décor/pnj/monster objects, migrates the deprecated single object, de-dups, null book) + findObject (resolve/dangling/empty); BookService.updateEdge sets+clears prereq without dropping the label
test_coverage.integration: OutgoingChoices via App: toggle « pré-requis caché » + pick an object persists prereq by id + shows ⊘; a prereq pointing at a deleted object shows ⚠

iterations_log.label: iteration-4 (countdown)
architecture_choices: The per-choice COUNTDOWN rides the EDGE (Edge.countdown?: ChoiceCountdown { delay, fallback }), persisted via the SAME updateEdge as the label + prereq — EdgePatch gained countdown: ChoiceCountdown | null (null clears, omitted untouched); the three fields are independent and editing one never clobbers the others (mirrors the iter-3 prereq).

New ChoiceCountdownEditor (mirrors ChoicePrereqEditor): a « compte à rebours » Toggle + a Délai Stepper (clamped 5–60s, default 15 — the shared brain Stepper enforces the bounds) + the shared brain TargetPicker for the fallback node (which excludes structural screens + self, KR-067, and surfaces a deleted target, KR-021). Controlled — OutgoingChoices persists each change.

Referential-integrity sweep (KR-063): the row validates BOTH rules against the live book — prereq vs collectObjects (⊘ / ⚠), countdown.fallback vs getNode (⏱ Ns when resolved, ⏱ « repli manquant » when  or deleted). A choice may carry BOTH a prereq and a countdown (KR-065) — they are independent edge fields; the play-mode « ticks only while visible » semantic is captured but not executed (editor scope).
deviations_from_plan: The play-mode countdown BEHAVIOUR (the actual ticking, expiry, hide-while-prereq-unmet KR-065) is out of editor scope — the slice captures the rule + validates its references. The fallback edge is NOT drawn on the canvas as an authored edge (it is a rule reference, like the PNJ « mène à » target); promoting it to a rendered/derived edge could fold into deriveAutomaticEdges later.

test_coverage.unit: BookService.updateEdge — sets/clears countdown independent of label/prereq
test_coverage.integration: OutgoingChoices via App — toggling « compte à rebours » persists { delay:15, fallback: } + surfaces the unset fallback; a configured countdown shows « ⏱ Ns », a dangling fallback shows « ⏱ repli manquant »

resolved_decisions: Two linking modes — new branch vs relink to existing — both in the skeleton; relink enables loops/convergence.
Mounted in node-editor's choices slot via the brain SlotRegistry; choice-linking owns edges, node-editor owns node text.
Hidden-prerequisite and countdown are per-choice rules; a choice may carry both, and the countdown only ticks while visible (KR-065).
Countdown délai is a free numeric input (seconds), default 15 s, clamped 5–60 s.
resolved_decisions_followups: Branch removal (the row ✕) is a DANGEROUS action — destructive + irreversible — so it is gated behind a confirmation dialog (DeleteBranchDialog over the brain Modal, confirmTone='error'), per the dangerous-action rule. The dialog states the target NODE is never deleted (only the link) and, when this is the node's SOLE incoming link, warns it will become unreachable — the KR-064 orphan prompt, computed live from the book. Done outside the iter-2 plan on user request; folds into the V2 slice (no bump).
open_questions: Promote the countdown fallback (and the PNJ « mène à » / monster victoire/fuite) config references to rendered/derived canvas edges via deriveAutomaticEdges — a cross-feature follow-up (KR-067).
